limits: Compiler results apply only to recorded source bytes, Swift 6.4 Apple build, SDK, SIL phase, arguments and paired controls; supplied 6.4.1 Linux outcomes remain separate.

Compile-only probes target macOS 27; runtime binaries use host-compatible defaults. No newer-API execution, older-target compatibility, performance, whole-program proof or arbitrary foreign-alias guarantee is established.

Behavioral acceptance requires one accepted run per case/runtime after affected reruns; five final-snapshot runs and19 unchanged-content carries satisfy that contract. Feedback-informed repeated cases are neither held-out evaluation nor statistical reliability.

Semantic reviewers own complete per-run rubric/trace judgments. This final review checks those records and final evidence integrity/carry-forward; it does not claim to have rerun every compiler command, native run, or independently repeated all semantic reviews.
Full native artifacts, evaluator engines and receipts live at recorded temporary paths; deleting them prevents strict reverification.
Parent may copy reviewed final-answer draft and add review completion metadata; materially broader post-review assertions require reconciliation with this evidence.
